content: रभस {%a.%} [रभ्-असच् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 116</ls>] .²1 Violent, impetuous, fierce, wild. .²2 Strong, intense, vehement, powerful, ardent, eager (as desire <ab>&c.</ab>); रभसया नु दिगन्तदिदृक्षया <ls>Ki. 5. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 61</ls>; <ls>Mu. 5. 24</ls>. .²3 Rash, precipitate. .²4 Joyful, glad. .²5 <ab>Ved.</ab> Strengthening. .{@-सः@} .²1 Violence, force, impetuosity, haste, speed, hurry, vehemence, आलीषु केलीरभसेन बाला मुहुर्ममालापमुपालपन्ती <ls>Bv. 2. 12</ls>; त्वभिसरणरभसेन वलन्ती <ls>Gīt. 6</ls>; <ls>Śi. 6. 13</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">11. 23</ls>; <ls>Ki. 9. 47</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 7. 9. 15</ls>. .²2 Rashness, precipitateness, headlong haste; अतिरभसकृतानां कर्मणामाविपत्तेर्भवति हृदयदाही शल्यतुल्यो विपाकः <ls>Bh. 2. 99</ls>; त्यजति न मृगव्याधरभसः <ls>Śivamahimna 22</ls>. .²3 Anger, passion, rage, fury; रक्तेक्षणेन च मनाग्रभसं दधानौ <ls>Bhāg. 3. 15. 28</ls>. .²4 Regret, sorrow. .²5 Joy, pleasure, delight; मनसि रभसविभवे हरिरुदयतु सुकृतेन <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>. .²6 Ardent desire, eagerness. .²7 Poison. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of a magical incantation recited over weapons.
